text.tspan: 08 · Proposed: Route 53 hybrid, with the anycast node groups
DNS services VPC (on-prem rule not associated)
Loop rule: aws-dns-a/b send on-prem zones straight to the on-prem servers, and the on-prem rule isn't associated with their VPC.
Otherwise: AWS node → VPC Resolver → rule → .53 → back to the same AWS node.
